key_insight: DP-Learner predicts electronic-structure Hamiltonians directly as operator blocks, avoiding the representation mismatch and repeated transformations of irreducible-tensor approaches.
engineering_relevance: Its matrix-based equivariant architecture targets more accurate, faster Hamiltonian prediction with representations better aligned to hardware execution and memory management.
method: Pass messages directly on Hamiltonian-like matrices or tensors in direct-product space.
Preserve rotation, spin-rotation, and inversion equivariance using Lie-generator embeddings and weighted products and contractions, without explicit Clebsch–Gordan decomposition.

evidence_signal: The authors introduce MP-HAM-110K with over 110,000 structures across 68 elements, including Hamiltonian and wavefunction data, and report improved accuracy and inference efficiency on it and Materials-HAM-SOC.
watch_item: The abstract provides no numerical gains or hardware details, so the magnitude and portability of the reported speedup require verification.
paper_title: Equivariant Deep Learning in Direct-Product Space for Electronic-Structure Hamiltonian Prediction
